mainEntity.name: Who is the BabeFit Program designed for?

acceptedAnswer.text: The BabeFit Program is designed for women of all fitness levels who are looking to improve their strength, endurance, and overall well-being. It is suitable for beginners wanting to start their fitness journey, as well as experienced individuals looking for a challenging and supportive environment. A practical tradeoff to consider is if you prefer co-ed training; this program offers a women-only focus, which might be a benefit or a limitation depending on your preference.
